MediaRecipe

A complete growth medium formulation for culturing microorganisms. This is the root entity - one per YAML file.

Attribute	Range	Cardinality	Status	Description
id	string	single	required	Stable canonical external CultureMech identifier for this media recipe. Immutable after issuance and never reused; lifecycle is published in data/culturemech_recipe_catalog.tsv.
id_lineage_token	string	single	optional	Internal immutable lineage witness for legacy records that predate the ID-assignment curation event. This is not an external identifier and must never be copied to another record or changed after publication.
name	string	single	required	Human-readable medium name (e.g., "LB Broth", "M9 Minimal Medium")
original_name	string	single	optional	Original name from source database before filename sanitization. May contain special characters like /, :, %, (, ), ', ", <, >, &, #, etc. This field preserves the exact name as it appears in the source database.
category	CategoryEnum	single	recommended	Broad category for o
